text:
Noah Kim: Hi team, received my welcome kit but the dock cable is USB-A not USB-C and the monitor shipment shows delivered to the wrong address (my old place). Also when I try to access redwood-sec I get redirected to a captive portal asking to register device. Not sure who to ping.
Lina (People Ops): Welcome Noah! Sorry about the mix. Pinged IT and shipping. If you want, we can move the delivery to the office for pickup.
IT_Desk: Hey Noah 44b sorry for the mess. Can you DM the tracking number and the wrong address shown? For the captive portal, do you see a page asking for a device name or MAC registration?
Noah Kim: Tracking: 1ZTEST00000000001. Delivered to: 123 Old St, Apt 2. My current address: 789 New Ave. Captive portal asks: "Register this device to corp network" and requests MAC + device name.
shipping-bot: Exception logged: delivery_misroute. Warehouse will redirect. Replacement pickup option created: RWD-PICK-8802.
IT_Desk: Thanks. We'll send a same-day replacement dock (USB-C cable) and request pickup of the misdelivered monitor. For the captive portal, we require device registration for corp devices. If you give us your MAC (run `ifconfig | grep ether` or Windows `getmac`), we can add it to the device registry so you can skip the captive flow.
Noah Kim: MAC DM'd: 8a:1b:c3:4d:5e:6f. Also can you confirm office pickup address/time?
Sam (Facilities): Hi Noah, you can pick up at SF office reception (W 4th) between 9am-5pm Mon-Fri. We'll hold for 7 days.
IT_Desk: Added MAC to registry and forced DHCP renew. Try reconnecting to redwood-sec now. Also replacement dock shipping created: RWD-REPL-77221 ETA 1 business day.
Noah Kim: Reconnected and captive portal bypassed. Wi-Fi works. Thanks!
Lina (People Ops): Great 60a welcome aboard! We'll keep the hardware ticket open until the correct monitor is back in your hands.
IT_Desk: Closing network/auth portion, leaving hardware follow-up on INC-2026-0499. Tracking and pickup updates will be emailed by shipping-bot.
Noah Kim: Appreciate the quick help everyone!
